verdict_detail: The stored data determine every one-link endpoint amplitude and the oriented species pairing, but they do not determine the edgewise charge-plane transport or the passive history push-forward. Therefore no unique blind stationary finite Dirac operator follows from the current action.

endpoint_operator.formula: T_tilde[f,e] = C5(H_e) + C43(Xi_3,e + J43 q_f/3) + i C45(Xi_5,e + J45 Delta g(q_f)/5)

oriented_species_pairing.formula: h_fg = q_f.q_g + i n.(q_f x q_g), n=(1,1,1)/sqrt(3)
oriented_species_pairing.limitation: h_fg supplies one oriented complex species line. It does not define transport of that line over edges and does not itself contract the generation-space flags.

new_exact_one_link_passive_candidate.scientific_status: exact for the stated uniform one-link push-forward; not yet identified by the theory as the physical passive history operator

why_rho0_does_not_finish_K0.type_mismatch: rho0 acts on the 16-dimensional exterior carrier, whereas K0 needed by the relative matter operator acts on the generation triplet after typed two-sheet history transport.
why_rho0_does_not_finish_K0.missing_map: No stored channel or completely positive push-forward maps rho0 through the edge histories into a positive generation-space K0.
why_rho0_does_not_finish_K0.required_history_formula: K0_history = Pi_+ sum_omega P0(omega) Mhat[0,omega]^* Mhat[0,omega] Pi_+, with Mhat[0,omega] the ordered passive two-sheet product.
why_rho0_does_not_finish_K0.consequence: K0_uniform=(23/45)I3 is a natural one-link candidate, while A_vac^*A_vac and history-averaged K0 are inequivalent candidates already present conceptually. The current action selects none of them.

exact_transport_obstruction.charge_plane: Q is the oriented real two-dimensional standard representation of S3, equivalently one complex line.
exact_transport_obstruction.group_fact: A5 has no nontrivial real two-dimensional representation.
exact_transport_obstruction.proof: Any homomorphism A5 -> O(2) is trivial: its kernel is normal; simplicity makes a nontrivial map injective, but finite subgroups of O(2) are cyclic or dihedral and contain no copy of A5. With the trivial A5 action on Q, Hom_A5(Q,4)=0 because the A5 quartet has no invariant vector.
exact_transport_obstruction.conclusion: The stored nonzero J43 and J45 can be S3-equivariant in one normalizer frame, but cannot be extended as one constant nonzero A5-equivariant map over the full edge orbit. A connection/transition law is mathematically necessary.

minimal_missing_tensor.purpose: transport q_f and its oriented phase into every local Hom(3,3') amplitude before ordered two-sheet multiplication
minimal_missing_tensor.minimum_claim: The current 30-edge alphabet already requires 19 independent U(1) cycle holonomies before any larger U(3) generation connection is considered.

remaining_phase_ambiguity.fact: Multiplicity one fixes each Clebsch line, not the relative scalar phase between distinct Clebsch lines.
remaining_phase_ambiguity.normalized_complex_freedom: U(1)^3/U(1)_overall = U(1)^2 before imposing a common real/Hodge convention
remaining_phase_ambiguity.after_hidden_hodge_pairing: At least the relative phase between the fiveplet block and the Hodge-paired hidden block remains to be derived from a common real structure and chain orientation.
remaining_phase_ambiguity.observable_effect: The equally equivariant C43 sign choice changes the blind mixing frames; the C45 sign choice complex-conjugates the CP-odd invariants while leaving absolute mixing unchanged.
remaining_phase_ambiguity.status: not fixed by the stored null-space normalizations

spectral_no_go.consequence: Any sum of separate spectral or heat actions is constant on a 16-dimensional relative-orientation space.

action_underdetermination.missing_selection: The current theory supplies no unique contraction, relative coefficient, edge transport, or passive history normalization for these inequivalent joint invariants.
action_underdetermination.failed_minimal_completion: The archived blind Wilson-KL test chose the trivial/common edge embedding and a real Wilson cost. It failed, and it retained an exact conjugate-chirality free-energy degeneracy.
action_underdetermination.why_no_stationary_point_is_reported_as_p: Choosing a different connection, cross-invariant coefficient, Clebsch phase, or K0 because of its output would be a new axiom or a fit.
